name: indonesia-economic-data
description: Indonesian and ASEAN economic data for AI agents: inflation, CPI, GDP, sector shares, and FX rates against IDR. No API key required.
long_description: Gives AI agents real Indonesian and ASEAN economic numbers instead of guesses. 85 time series (14,122 observations, 1960-2026) from World Bank Open Data (CC BY 4.0) plus daily ECB exchange rates against IDR. Tools: search series, fetch a series with period filters, latest FX rates, ASEAN cross-country comparison, indicator catalogue, and health check. Runs locally inside the bundle - no API key and no account needed.

tools.name: cari_series
tools.description: Search economic data series by keyword (Indonesia, ASEAN, inflation, GDP, FX, agriculture)

tools.name: ambil_series
tools.description: Fetch data points for one series, with optional period range

series_id.description: Exact series ID from cari_series, e.g. 'wb:idn:FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG'

tools.name: kurs_terkini
tools.description: Latest USD/EUR/SGD/CNY/JPY/MYR exchange rate against IDR, with 30-day history

base.description: Source currency: USD, EUR, SGD, CNY, JPY, or MYR (default USD)

tools.name: banding_asean
tools.description: Compare one indicator across Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines, Singapore

tools.name: daftar_indikator
tools.description: List all available indicators and FX pairs
